rationale: CRISPRi FlowFISH screen of transcription-factor promoters in female mouse ES cells at day 2 of differentiation, sorted by Xist RNA level; column names give replicate and bin. Each replicate is one transduction sorted into all bins, so replicate is a blocking term (1 residual df). Genes are promoter-level (_p1/_p2). Activators of Xist (Zic3) should be depleted in the Xist-high bin; this matches the authors' own High vs Negative analysis.
